description: The chart illustrates two sets of four bars comparing reasoning methods in terms of accuracy and token count, with the left group representing “Accuracy (%)” and the right group representing “Token Count.” The categories are encoded by bar color and legend (CoT in red, CoD in orange, CCoT in light blue, and CoUT in green), and the bars are arranged horizontally in two separated clusters rather than along a labeled categorical axis. The left vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale from 70 to 100 with tick marks at 5-unit intervals; in this accuracy cluster, the red CoT bar is labeled 91.19, the orange CoD bar is 80.89, the light-blue CCoT bar is 88.50, and the green CoUT bar is 88.40. The right vertical axis is labeled “Token Count” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 800 with tick marks at 100-unit intervals; in this token-count cluster, the red CoT bar is labeled 676.85, the orange CoD bar is 534.24, the light-blue CCoT bar is 445.91, and the green CoUT bar is 354.46. Each bar has its numeric value annotated above it, there is no visible sorting by magnitude within each cluster, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond distinct colors and the value labels.
